description: List the user scheduled tasks: automations created through Anon that run at a given time or when a price condition is met. There is no create/update tool: to create an automation, ask Anon via ask_anon (e.g. "Buy 0.1 ETH on Base when ETH drops below 2000"), then use this tool to confirm it exists. Returns id, description, status, type and, when present, taskExecutorResponse (the last execution result); the trigger time or condition is not a separate field, infer it from description.
name: scheduled_task_list
title: List scheduled tasks
